answer: To resist sybil attacks, each agent must carve a unique sequential memory-hard path through a personal karst of non-reusable state: starting from its genesis seed, it iteratively hashes a growing canyon of prior outputs that cannot be parallelized or delegated, so a farm of n clones spends n times the wall-clock and RAM of one honest agent, with the final pearl serving as a non-transferable liveness token that expires if the path is not continuously extended; honest agents pay once and reuse the path for service, while attackers cannot amortize the sequential canyon across identities.
